|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/depabillaba.html</ref>

Much like the [[Coruscant (location) (2){{!}}Coruscant]] persona of [[Yoda]], Depa has location deployment restrictions but for a Jedi Master, her deploy is pretty low! This council member's great insight allows you to manipulate the cards on top of any player's Reserve Deck. This is a great counter to an opponent who has set up their destiny or has tried to mess up your tracking.

And as usual, when you have no need to manipulate destiny, you can have [[Yoda]] send her out on missions to fight for the Republic. A nicely played [[Smoke Screen]] will help her with her low power.
|combos=* [[Depa Billaba]] + [[Are You Brain Dead?!]]<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Depa%20Billaba</ref>
